definitions.explanation: The precious metal platinum, used in jewelry, industrial applications, and as an investment asset. In Japanese, also widely used figuratively to describe the highest-tier or most exclusive category of products, services, and membership levels.

examples.japanese: プラチナ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a platinum ring as a present.

examples.japanese: プラチナ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: If you become a platinum member, you can receive special benefits.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧プラチナ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{入手|にゅうしゅ}→入手：11636_nyuushu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Tickets for that concert are platinum tickets — extremely difficult to get.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From Spanish platina; the figurative sense (the most exclusive tier) follows English usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プラチナ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ (platinum member)
- プラチナ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ (platinum credit card)
- プラチナ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧ (platinum ticket — a ticket that is extremely hard to obtain)
- プラチナ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧ (platinum generation — active senior citizens)

USAGE:
As a tier name it sits above ゴールド in loyalty programs and credit cards.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白金|はっきん}→白金：18677_hakkin⟧: platinum — the scientific term, used in chemistry and on some jewelry labels; never for the figurative tier
